title: Sage state_machine record
description: A state_machine record (StateMachineRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another state_machine record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

initial.description: The state a machine starts in (a nested one enters its parents first), and goes back to when its saved state is not in the machine any more. (string, default "")

states.description: The states, by name; a state may hold states of its own (nested, or parallel regions). Names are unique across the machine. (Dictionary<string, MachineState>)

enter.description: What entering it does: the activator is the subject, the machine the other. (List<IAction>)

enter+.description: Adds to "enter": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

enter-.description: Removes these from "enter" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

exit.description: What leaving it does, before the transition's then and the next state's enter. (List<IAction>)

exit+.description: Adds to "exit": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

exit-.description: Removes these from "exit" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

during.description: What it does each tick it is in it, from the tick after it is entered, before its transitions are tried. (List<IAction>)

during+.description: Adds to "during": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

during-.description: Removes these from "during" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

transitions.description: Where it can go, tried in order: the first that matches wins. (List<StateTransition>)

on.description: An input's name: only when that input arrives at the entity (any name; registered ones too) (string)

when.description: Only while this holds, asked about the activator with the machine as the other. (ICondition)

after.description: Only once the machine has been in the state this long; 0 = no wait. Unit: s. At least 0. (float)

then.description: What taking it does, between the old state's exit and the new one's enter. (List<IAction>)

then+.description: Adds to "then": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

then-.description: Removes these from "then" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

fade.description: anim_graph only: how long taking it cross-fades, over the state's fade; left out, the state's. Unit: s. At least 0. (float?)

ease.description: anim_graph only: the curve taking it cross-fades along, over the state's ease; left out, the state's. (Ease?)
